sources.requirements_and_source_effect_limits: The main guard does not cover imports: kbdrive.load_world_and_interface is imported at module top level. That helper was located in the pinned tree but not fetched or reviewed; its loading behavior, import effects and dependencies remain unverified. The main code creates a simulated interface only when the helper returns none; otherwise it uses or wraps the supplied interface. It initializes that interface, reads positions, opens a ghost editor and can send moveToPosition after the registered action. TimedLooper uses the interface's control rate plus a 0.01-second sleep; neither timing nor real-time operation was measured. Normal loop exit closes the interface and viewer, without an encompassing try/finally guarantee. Models, assets, controllers and exact package/robot combinations were not reviewed or tested.

sources.requirements_and_source_effect_limits: Run from Python3/demos/plan or supply an explicit world path. The default loads ../../../data/robots/jaco.rob; this Jaco discovery label does not establish model compatibility. Default SBL planning uses restart/shortcutting, active DOFs auto, a 500-iteration limit and a nominal 10-second budget. CLOSED_LOOP_TEST and PLAN_CARTESIAN_TEST are both zero by default. SIMPLIFY_TYPE=ConvexHull changes geometry; fidelity and collision behavior are unverified. Direct waypoint-editor feasibility rejection is disabled. Execution can write planningtest.configs resources and test.path and visualize a path for 60 seconds. Model/mesh bytes and licenses were not reviewed; package/native-library combinations, planning success and timing were not tested.
